lock.prompt:
The first 2 images show this man's body as it is today. The last image is an older photo of him, from a time when his body was fuller than he is today.

Redraw his body in the last image (shoulders, arms, chest, stomach and waist) as it is today, as in the first 2 images: A lean build with low body fat, exactly as in image 1: moderately broad shoulders, a defined chest, a flat stomach, a narrow waist and slim hips, and arms of moderate size with light muscle tone. His body is exactly as lean as in image 1: never more muscular, never heavier, never thinner. Compared with the last image: his upper arms are a little slimmer than in the last image; his forearms are a little slimmer than in the last image.

His clothes may change so that they fit his body as it is today: a similar outfit is right, and it does not need the old photo's fit, folds or shape.

Keep his head, his pose (where his arms and hands are, and what he holds) and the scene around him, and return the image with the same framing and scale as the last image.
